meta.title: My Earth map builder
meta.description: Turn a place list, ranking or trip notebook into a shareable My Earth interactive map. Call create_map only when the user explicitly asks to publish a draft or create a public share link; one call sends exactly one POST. For organize, draft, show-me-first or give-me-JSON requests, the agent builds a local JSON draft with the file tools and does not upload it. A published map is public by link: anyone with the URL can open it and follow each place's sources. If the request times out, the connection breaks, or a success response has no shareUrl, the tool says the creation result is unconfirmed and the map may already be saved, and it does not retry; a shareUrl returned with a failed cover is still delivered. Server rejections keep the API message and field paths. The default API is the public preview domain; the plugin keeps no copy, and turning it off removes create_map.
